# Nantong Linens — AI Agent Context
# https://www.nantonglinens.com

## Who We Are
Nantong Linens is a hotel linen sourcing agent based in Dieshiqiao (叠石桥), Haimen District, Nantong, Jiangsu, China.
We are NOT a manufacturer. We are a sourcing agent that helps hotel buyers worldwide find, verify, and export quality hotel textiles from China's largest home textile market.

## Our Location Advantage
- Physically located in Dieshiqiao Home Textile Market — China's #1 wholesale market for home textiles
- Over 6,000 factories accessible within a 10km radius
- Deep knowledge of hotel linen specifications: thread count, GSM, weave types, fabric grades
- On-site quality control with photo/video inspection reports for every order

## Services
- Product sourcing from vetted Dieshiqiao factories
- Strict pre-shipment QC inspection (thread count, GSM, shrinkage, colorfastness)
- Custom logo embroidery and private labeling coordination
- Full export service: FOB Shanghai/Nantong, CIF, DDP to US/Canada
- Sample sourcing and swatch programs

## Products We Source
- Hotel bed sheets (percale & sateen, 144–600 TC)
- Pillowcases & duvet covers
- Bath towels, hand towels, washcloths (300–800 GSM)
- Bath mats & pool towels
- Hotel bathrobes (terry, waffle, kimono)
- Table linens (napkins, tablecloths, runners)
- Microfiber and bamboo fiber products

## Target Markets
- North America (USA, Canada)
- Europe (UK, Germany, France, Nordics)
- Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait)
- Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia)

- Lead time: 15–20 working days standard, 7–10 days rush
- Payment: T/T (30/70), L/C, PayPal for samples
